paragraphs.en: Difflet: A Fast Inference Engine for Diffusion Transformer Models on AWS Trainium
paragraphs.zh: Difflet：一个用于 AWS Trainium 上扩散 Transformer 模型的快速推理引擎

paragraphs.en: Bin Ma 1 Min Yu 1 Vijay Kodamalla 1 Jialin Liu 1 Dong Li 1 2
paragraphs.zh: Bin Ma 1 Min Yu 1 Vijay Kodamalla 1 Jialin Liu 1 Dong Li 1 2

paragraphs.en: On AWS Trainium2, every component of a diffusion model runs as a program compiled ahead of time for fixed shapes, while pipelines differ across models, prompt lengths across requests, and caching decisions across denoising steps. We present Difflet, a serving engine in which five model pipelines share one compilation backend, joint attention is split across cores by attention head, and a host controller decides at each denoising step whether to run the denoiser or reuse its earlier output. A small probe program computes the caching signal on the device and returns one number per step, and a resident model process keeps every program loaded across requests. Across five image and video model families, fused attention accelerates denoiser steps by 1.2–4.3 × \times over the same framework using PyTorch/XLA attention, and at 32.8k visual tokens it is the only attention that compiles. On four of the five models, resident serving is 1.5–3.4 × \times faster than standalone runs that reload weights from a warm file cache for each generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在 AWS Trainium2 上，扩散模型的每个组件都作为针对固定形状预先编译的程序运行，而流水线因模型而异，请求之间的提示长度不同，去噪步骤之间的缓存决策也不相同。 我们提出 Difflet，这是一个服务引擎，其中五个模型流水线共享一个编译后端，联合注意力按注意力头在核心之间拆分，并且一个主机控制器在每个去噪步骤决定是运行去噪器还是复用其先前的输出。 一个小型探针程序在设备上计算缓存信号并每步返回一个数值，一个常驻模型进程在请求之间保持所有程序处于已加载状态。 在五个图像和视频模型家族中，融合注意力将去噪器步骤加速 1.2–4.3 × \times，相比使用 PyTorch/XLA 注意力的同一框架；在 32.8k 视觉 token 时，它是唯一能够完成编译的注意力实现。 在五个模型中的四个上，常驻服务比每次生成都从热文件缓存重新加载权重的独立运行快 1.5–3.4 × \times。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion transformers generate images and videos through repeated denoising steps. Each step applies a transformer to a noisy latent representation, using the timestep and conditioning inputs to predict the noise, or for flow-matching models the velocity, from which the sampler computes a less noisy latent Peebles & Xie (2023) . Higher image resolutions and longer videos increase the number of visual tokens processed at each step. Repeating this computation raises both generation latency and the accelerator time consumed by each request. Efficient serving therefore requires shortening the user’s wait while controlling the cost per generated image or video.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散变换器通过反复的去噪步骤生成图像和视频。 每一步都将变换器应用于带噪声的潜在表示，利用时间步和条件输入来预测噪声（对于流匹配模型则是速度），采样器据此计算出噪声更小的潜在表示 Peebles & Xie (2023) 。 更高的图像分辨率和更长的视频会增加每一步需要处理的视觉 token 数量。 重复这一计算既增加了生成延迟，也增加了每个请求消耗的加速器时间。 因此，高效的服务需要在缩短用户等待时间的同时，控制每张生成图像或每个生成视频的成本。

paragraphs.en: Most diffusion serving today runs on NVIDIA GPUs, whose high price and limited supply make the production cost hard to manage. Cloud providers have therefore built cost-efficient, customized accelerators. AWS Trainium Fan et al. (2024) is one of those examples: it has been reported that Trainium2 instances provide 30–40% better price-performance than GPU-based EC2 P5e and P5en instances Amazon Web Services (2026i) , and distributed LLM training on first-generation Trainium cost up to 46.3% less than on A100-based instances in selected workloads, at comparable or higher training throughput Fu et al. (2024) . Each Trainium chip contains several NeuronCores (cores for short), and the Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) lets programmers write kernels that choose which of a core’s tensor, vector, scalar, and general-purpose engines runs each operation and when data moves Amazon Web Services (2026j) ; Amazon Web Services (2026b) ; Amazon Web Services (2026c) . With Trainium’s production software stack, serving a diffusion model means running programs that are compiled ahead of time for fixed shapes and called by a host process at every denoising step. Serving diffusion models under this execution model requires deciding what must be fixed in compiled programs and what must remain flexible across models, requests, and denoising steps. This creates challenges at three levels: accommodating different model pipelines, distributing each denoiser evaluation across cores, and reusing results across denoising steps.
paragraphs.zh: 如今大多数扩散模型推理服务都运行在 NVIDIA GPU 上，其高昂的价格和有限的供应使得生产成本难以控制。 因此，云服务商构建了高性价比的定制加速器。AWS Trainium（Fan 等人）便是其中一例。 （2024）有报道称，Trainium2 实例相比基于 GPU 的 EC2 P5e 和 P5en 实例具有 30–40% 更优的性价比（Amazon Web Services，2026i），并且在选定的工作负载中，使用第一代 Trainium 进行分布式 LLM 训练的成本比基于 A100 的实例低达 46.3%，同时训练吞吐量相当甚至更高（Fu 等人，2024）。 每个 Trainium 芯片包含若干 NeuronCore（简称核心），而 Neuron Kernel Interface（NKI）让程序员能够编写内核，选择核心的张量、向量、标量和通用引擎中的哪一个来执行每个操作，以及数据何时移动（Amazon Web Services，2026j；Amazon Web Services，2026b；Amazon Web Services，2026c）。 在 Trainium 的生产软件栈下，为扩散模型提供服务意味着运行那些针对固定形状提前编译、并由宿主进程在每个去噪步骤中调用的程序。 在这种执行模型下服务扩散模型，需要决定哪些内容必须在编译后的程序中固定，哪些内容必须在模型、请求和去噪步骤之间保持灵活。 这带来了三个层面的挑战：适配不同的模型流水线、将每次去噪器求值分布到多个核心上，以及跨去噪步骤复用结果。

paragraphs.en: First, diffusion models differ in their encoders, denoiser, and decoder and in the order they call them, yet on Trainium every one of these components must be compiled before serving. Ahead-of-time (AOT) compilation specializes each component for the selected tensor shapes, data type, and parallel configuration Amazon Web Services (2026d) . When compilation, loading, and invocation are embedded in each model’s pipeline, supporting another model requires assembling another execution path around these constraints. The challenge is to add a model without writing another compilation and loading path for it.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，扩散模型在编码器、去噪器、解码器以及调用它们的顺序上各不相同，而在 Trainium 上，每一个这样的组件都必须在提供服务之前完成编译。 提前（AOT）编译会针对所选的张量形状、数据类型和并行配置对每个组件进行专门化处理 Amazon Web Services (2026d) 。 当编译、加载和调用被嵌入到每个模型的流水线中时，要支持另一个模型就需要围绕这些约束再组装一条新的执行路径。 挑战在于，在不为某个模型另行编写编译和加载路径的情况下添加该模型。

paragraphs.en: Second, distributing a denoiser across Trainium cores requires finding a parallel configuration that both the model and the compiled kernels support. Tensor parallelism (TP) partitions weights Shoeybi et al. (2019) ; sequence and context parallelism (SP, CP) partition tokens Korthikanti et al. (2022) ; Jacobs et al. (2023) ; Liu et al. (2023) ; and classifier-free guidance (CFG) parallelism executes conditional and unconditional denoiser passes concurrently Ho & Salimans (2022) . Each choice changes tensor shapes, data layouts, and communication requirements, so these choices cannot be combined freely. For example, joint attention over visual and text tokens must exclude padded text keys from its softmax. The masked attention path used here requires valid keys to be contiguous and query and key lengths to match Amazon Web Services (2026e) . A direct partition that keeps queries local while gathering all keys violates the second requirement. Such incompatibilities make parallel configuration a question of execution feasibility as well as performance, and discovering them only after compilation is costly.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，将去噪器分布到 Trainium 核心上，需要找到一个模型和编译后内核都支持的并行配置。 张量并行（TP）对权重进行划分 Shoeybi et al. (2019)；序列并行与上下文并行（SP、CP）对词元进行划分 Korthikanti et al. (2022)；Jacobs et al. (2023)；Liu et al. (2023)；而无分类器引导（CFG）并行则并发执行条件与无条件去噪器前向过程 Ho & Salimans (2022)。 每种选择都会改变张量形状、数据布局和通信需求，因此这些选择不能随意组合。 例如，对视觉词元和文本词元进行的联合注意力必须将填充的文本键排除在其 softmax 之外。 此处使用的带掩码注意力路径要求有效的键是连续的，且查询长度与键长度相匹配 Amazon Web Services (2026e)。 一种让查询保持在本地、同时收集所有键的直接划分方式违反了第二个要求。 这些不兼容性使得并行配置不仅是性能问题，也是执行可行性的问题，而只有在编译之后才发现这些问题代价高昂。

paragraphs.en: Third, step caching, a common optimization for diffusion transformers, must obtain a cheap reuse signal despite Trainium’s compilation and memory constraints. Methods such as TeaCache use early denoiser features to decide when to reuse prior results Liu et al. (2025a) . In our AOT execution path, these features remain inside the compiled denoiser, while the host controls whether to invoke it. Computing the signal separately on the host adds latency; a device implementation instead needs additional memory for weights and saved features alongside the partitioned denoiser. This placement tradeoff can undermine caching: our host path makes Wan’s denoising loop 11% longer than without caching, while HunyuanVideo already occupies 22 of 24 GiB per logical core before adding a probe.
paragraphs.zh: 第三，步缓存（step caching）是扩散Transformer的一种常见优化手段，但在Trainium的编译与内存限制下，它必须获得一个开销低廉的复用信号。 诸如TeaCache之类的方法利用去噪器早期特征来决定何时复用先前的结果 Liu et al. (2025a) 。 在我们的AOT执行路径中，这些特征留在编译后的去噪器内部，而主机控制是否调用它。 在主机上单独计算该信号会增加延迟；而设备端实现则需要在分区去噪器之外，为权重和保存的特征额外占用内存。 这种部署上的权衡可能削弱缓存的效果：我们的主机路径使Wan的去噪循环比不使用缓存时长11%，而HunyuanVideo在加入探针之前，每个逻辑核心的24 GiB内存中已被占用22 GiB。

sents.en: This placement tradeoff can undermine caching: our host path makes Wan’s denoising loop 11% longer than without caching, while HunyuanVideo already occupies 22 of 24 GiB per logical core before adding a probe.
sents.zh: 这种部署上的权衡可能削弱缓存的效果：我们的主机路径使Wan的去噪循环比不使用缓存时长11%，而HunyuanVideo在加入探针之前，每个逻辑核心的24 GiB内存中已被占用22 GiB。

paragraphs.en: We present Difflet, a serving engine for diffusion transformers on AWS Trainium2 built around one boundary: what is the same for every request is compiled, and what changes per request or per step stays on the host. Each component’s program fixes its shapes, data type, parallel configuration, and kernels; the model’s control flow, the prompt length, the decision to skip a step, and each request’s sampling state are left to the host. When such a value must reach or leave the device, Difflet passes it as a small runtime value instead of building a new program: the number of valid text keys going into attention, and one change score per step coming out of the caching probe.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Difflet，一个面向 AWS Trainium2 上扩散 Transformer 的服务引擎，其构建围绕一条边界：对所有请求都相同的内容被编译固化，而随请求或随步骤变化的内容则留在主机端。 每个组件的程序固定其形状、数据类型、并行配置和算子内核；而模型的控制流、提示长度、跳过某一步的决策以及每个请求的采样状态则交由主机处理。 当这类数值必须进入或离开设备时，Difflet 将其作为小的运行时数值传递，而不是构建新的程序：例如进入注意力机制的有效文本键的数量，以及缓存探针每步输出的一个变化分数。

paragraphs.en: To support different models, Difflet exploits what diffusion pipelines have in common. Their control flow differs, but all of them are built from conditioning encoders, a denoiser, and a decoder. Each of these components compiles to a program that depends only on its shape, data type, parallel configuration, and compiler version, and, where a device probe is fused into the denoiser, on whether the probe is present; runtime settings such as the caching cadence or threshold do not enter it. Difflet therefore keeps each model’s control flow in its own pipeline on the host and moves everything AOT compilation needs into a shared backend, driven by a short description of each model. The backend caches each compiled program under exactly these inputs, so a server restart or a new caching threshold reuses the program instead of recompiling it.
paragraphs.zh: 为了支持不同的模型，Difflet 利用了扩散流水线的共同之处。 它们的控制流程各不相同，但都由条件编码器、去噪器和解码器构成。 这些组件各自编译为一个程序，该程序仅依赖于其形状、数据类型、并行配置和编译器版本；当设备探测被融合进去噪器时，还取决于探测是否存在；诸如缓存节奏或阈值等运行时设置不会进入其中。 因此，Difflet 将每个模型的控制流程保留在主机上各自的流水线中，并把 AOT 编译所需的一切移入一个共享后端，该后端由每个模型的简短描述驱动。 后端在这些输入完全一致的情况下缓存每个编译后的程序，因此服务器重启或新的缓存阈值可以直接复用该程序，而无需重新编译。

paragraphs.en: For parallel execution, Difflet chooses each split by what Trainium’s attention kernels accept. For attention, it uses Ulysses-style context parallelism Jacobs et al. (2023) , which regroups the tokens by attention head, so each core holds every query and key for its heads and thus the same number of queries as keys. Difflet places the text padding after all valid keys, so the valid keys sit next to each other, and each request passes only the number of valid keys. One compiled program thus serves every prompt length, and the split result matches unsplit attention to within BF16 rounding. Difflet also rejects unsupported combinations before compiling rather than after a long compilation fails.
paragraphs.zh: 为了实现并行执行，Difflet 根据 Trainium 的注意力内核所接受的格式来选择每种切分方式。 在注意力方面，它采用 Jacobs 等人提出的 Ulysses 式上下文并行。 （2023），该方法按注意力头对词元重新分组，因此每个核心持有其各个头的所有查询和键，从而使查询数量与键数量相同。 Difflet 将文本填充放在所有有效键之后，因此有效键彼此相邻，且每个请求只传递有效键的数量。 这样，一个编译后的程序就能适用于每个提示词长度，且切分结果与未切分的注意力相比误差仅在 BF16 舍入范围内。 Difflet 还会在编译前而非在漫长编译失败后才拒绝不受支持的组合。

paragraphs.en: To skip denoising steps, Difflet estimates the output change outside the denoiser in one of two ways. A small compiled probe computes an early denoiser feature on the device, keeps the previous step’s feature there, and returns a single number to the host; because it loads only the weights of the layers it runs, it fits beside the denoiser even on HunyuanVideo. Alternatively, Difflet estimates the change from the outputs of earlier steps, which needs no additional program. In both cases, a host controller decides at each step whether to call the denoiser or reuse an earlier output.
paragraphs.zh: 为了跳过去噪步骤，Difflet 通过以下两种方式之一在去噪器之外估计输出的变化。 一个小型编译探针在设备上计算早期去噪器特征，并将上一步的特征保存在设备上，只向主机返回单个数值；由于它仅加载其所运行层的权重，因此即使在 HunyuanVideo 上也能与去噪器并存。 或者，Difflet 根据较早步骤的输出估计该变化，这不需要额外的程序。 在这两种情况下，主机控制器在每一步都决定是调用去噪器还是复用较早的输出。

paragraphs.en: We summarize our contributions as follows:

paragraphs.en: A shared Trainium backend through which one kernel or parallel mode serves different diffusion pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: 一个共享的 Trainium 后端，通过它，一个内核或并行模式可以服务于不同的扩散流水线。

paragraphs.en: Parallel execution planned as a serving decision, with split joint attention that matches unsplit attention.

paragraphs.zh: 围绕已编译降噪器的步骤缓存，可选择是否使用设备探测（device probe）。

paragraphs.en: Trainium2 architecture. AWS Trainium2 has eight physical NeuronCore-v3 cores and 96 GiB of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) for weights and activations Amazon Web Services (2026h) . Direct memory access (DMA) engines transfer tensors between HBM and SBUF Amazon Web Services (2026j) . The Tensor Engine handles matrix multiplication, Vector and Scalar handle normalization and activations, and GpSimd supports programmable SIMD. These engines can execute concurrently and overlap computation with data movement Amazon Web Services (2026b) ; Amazon Web Services (2026j) . Collective-communication cores support all-reduce and all-to-all Amazon Web Services (2026j) . We use the default LNC = 2 \mathrm{LNC}{=}2 configuration, which pairs physical cores into four logical cores per device, each with 24 GiB of HBM; all parallel configurations count logical cores Amazon Web Services (2026a) .

paragraphs.en: Difflet splits each model along the boundary of Section 1 : a pipeline on the host decides which components run and in what order, and a shared Trainium backend compiles, loads, and calls them (Figure 1 ). The pipeline is hardware-agnostic: it names the model’s encoders, denoiser, and decoder, the tensors that flow between them, and the shapes each one takes. A short model adapter connects the two: given a resolution, data type, and parallel configuration, it tells the backend which components to compile and how to shard each one.
paragraphs.zh: Difflet 沿第 1 节所述的边界对每个模型进行拆分：主机上的流水线决定哪些组件运行以及以何种顺序运行，而共享的 Trainium 后端负责编译、加载并调用这些组件（图 1）。 该流水线与硬件无关：它列出模型的编码器、去噪器和解码器，以及它们之间流动的张量和各自采用的形状。 一个简短的模型适配器将两者连接起来：给定分辨率、数据类型和并行配置，它会告诉后端要编译哪些组件以及如何对每个组件进行分片。

sents.zh: 一个简短的模型适配器将两者连接起来：给定分辨率、数据类型和并行配置，它会告诉后端要编译哪些组件以及如何对每个组件进行分片。

paragraphs.en: The model pipeline determines how tensors move through these components. For a generation request, conditioning encoders produce the context used during denoising, and the pipeline prepares the initial latent and timestep schedule. At each step, the denoiser predicts noise or a velocity field from the current latent, timestep, and encoder outputs. The diffusion scheduler uses this prediction to update the latent for the next step. After the final update, the decoder maps the latent to an image or video. The pipeline owns this iterative control flow, including model-specific conditioning and component choices.
paragraphs.zh: 模型流水线决定了张量如何在这些组件之间流动。 对于生成请求，条件编码器产生去噪过程中使用的上下文，流水线则准备初始潜变量和时间步计划。 在每一步中，去噪器根据当前潜变量、时间步和编码器输出预测噪声或速度场。 扩散调度器利用该预测更新潜变量，以便进入下一步。 在最终更新之后，解码器将潜变量映射为图像或视频。 流水线负责管理这一迭代控制流程，包括特定于模型的条件处理和组件选择。

paragraphs.en: Trainium requires components to be compiled for static tensor shapes. Before inference, Difflet therefore prepares the required components for the selected image resolution or video length, data type, and parallel configuration. The Trainium backend uses this information to compile each component ahead of time, verify that the required compiled artifacts are present and match the selected configuration, and load the programs and weights onto the assigned cores. These preparation steps are separate from the generation process: loading order can follow resource requirements while the model pipeline retains the model’s execution order.
paragraphs.zh: Trainium 要求各组件针对静态张量形状进行编译。 因此，Difflet 在推理之前，会针对所选的图像分辨率或视频长度、数据类型以及并行配置，准备好所需的组件。 Trainium 后端利用这些信息提前编译每个组件，验证所需的已编译产物存在且与所选配置匹配，并将程序和权重加载到分配的核上。 这些准备步骤与生成过程是分开的：加载顺序可以遵循资源需求，而模型流水线则保留模型的执行顺序。

paragraphs.en: During inference, the model pipeline runs in Python and calls the components’ programs with tensor inputs, receiving output tensors for the next stage or denoising step. Within each component, shared operator interfaces connect model operations to Trainium implementations, including NKI kernels and NeuronX Distributed (NxD) operations. The parallel configuration specifies how work is distributed across ranks and is checked against supported combinations. The backend organizes these ranks into groups for the selected parallel modes. Each model thus keeps its own control flow while sharing one backend. Because models call attention and collectives through shared operator interfaces, a kernel or parallel mode added once becomes available to every model that uses that interface.
paragraphs.zh: 在推理阶段，模型流水线在 Python 中运行，并以张量作为输入调用各组件的程序，接收输出的张量用于下一阶段或去噪步骤。 在每个组件内部，共享的算子接口将模型操作连接到 Trainium 实现，包括 NKI 内核和 NeuronX Distributed（NxD）操作。 并行配置指定工作如何在各个 rank 之间分布，并会根据支持的组合进行检查。 后端将这些 rank 组织成组，以支持所选的并行模式。 因此，每个模型在共享同一个后端的同时，保持自己的控制流。 由于模型通过共享的算子接口调用注意力机制和集合通信，只需添加一次的内核或并行模式即可对使用该接口的每个模型可用。

paragraphs.en: Difflet distributes each denoiser evaluation across cores with tensor, sequence, context, CFG, and data parallelism; each program fixes its parallel configuration, while the prompt length remains a runtime value. Each rank is one logical core, which pairs two physical NeuronCore-v3s under the default LNC = 2 \mathrm{LNC}{=}2 configuration. On the single-chip trn2.3xlarge , collectives between ranks stay on chip, with DMA engines moving data between the logical cores’ HBM Amazon Web Services (2026a) ; Amazon Web Services (2026j) . Within a rank, each attention kernel runs on both physical cores, which split the call’s heads between them Amazon Web Services (2026f) . Each physical core computes on tiles in its SBUF, whose 128 partitions set the tile height, and its Tensor Engine is a 128 × 128 128\times 128 systolic array Amazon Web Services (2026j) . Two properties shape the design below: compiled programs fix every tensor shape, and kernels process sequences in tiles of 128 tokens, one per SBUF partition. In joint attention, each query attends to both visual and text keys under a single softmax normalization. Distributed execution must preserve this normalization while excluding padding and counting replicated text keys only once. These requirements determine how Difflet redistributes tensors and combines results from Trainium’s fused attention kernels.
paragraphs.zh: Difflet 通过张量并行、序列并行、上下文并行、CFG 并行和数据并行，将每次去噪器评估分布到多个核心上；每个程序固定其并行配置，而提示词长度在运行时仍是一个可变的值。 每个逻辑核心即一个 rank，在默认的 LNC = 2 配置下，一个 rank 由两个物理 NeuronCore-v3 组成。 在单芯片的 trn2.3xlarge 上，各 rank 之间的集合通信保持在芯片内进行，由 DMA 引擎在逻辑核心的 HBM 之间搬运数据 Amazon Web Services (2026a)；Amazon Web Services (2026j)。 在一个 rank 内部，每个注意力核同时在两个物理核心上运行，两个物理核心分摊该次调用的头 Amazon Web Services (2026f)。 每个物理核心对其 SBUF 中的瓦片进行计算，SBUF 的 128 个分区决定了瓦片高度，其张量引擎是一个 128 × 128 的脉动阵列 Amazon Web Services (2026j)。 两个特性决定了下文的设计：编译后的程序固定每一个张量形状，且核以 128 个 token 的瓦片（每个 SBUF 分区一个瓦片）为单位处理序列。 在联合注意力中，每个查询在单一的 softmax 归一化下同时关注视觉键和文本键。 分布式执行必须保留这一归一化，同时排除填充，并且对复制的文本键只计数一次。 这些要求决定了 Difflet 如何重新分配张量以及如何合并来自 Trainium 融合注意力核的结果。

paragraphs.en: Tensor parallelism (TP) partitions linear-layer weights across ranks using the Megatron column and row decomposition Shoeybi et al. (2019) . Ranks in a TP group process the same tokens with different weight slices; an all-reduce sums the partial outputs and returns the result to each rank. Sequence parallelism (SP) partitions tokens within that group for normalization, modulation, and residual operations between linear layers Korthikanti et al. (2022) . An all-gather assembles the token partitions before the linear layers, and a reduce-scatter sums and partitions their outputs. The normalization, modulation, and residual operations run on the Vector and Scalar Engines, whose throughput is far below the Tensor Engine’s Amazon Web Services (2026b) ; SP divides this otherwise replicated work by the TP size while reusing the TP group.
paragraphs.zh: 张量并行（TP）使用 Megatron 的列分解与行分解方法（Shoeybi et al. (2019)）将线性层权重划分到各个秩（rank）上。 同一张量并行组中的各秩使用不同的权重分片处理相同的词元；一次 all-reduce 对各部分输出求和，并将结果返回给每个秩。 序列并行（SP）在该组内对词元进行划分，用于线性层之间的归一化、调制和残差操作（Korthikanti et al. (2022)）。 一次 all-gather 在线性层之前将词元分片组装起来，一次 reduce-scatter 则对线性层的输出求和并进行划分。 归一化、调制和残差操作运行在向量引擎与标量引擎上，其吞吐量远低于张量引擎（Amazon Web Services (2026b)）；SP 在复用张量并行组的同时，将这部分原本需要复制执行的工作按张量并行规模进行均分。

paragraphs.en: Each rank’s queries (Q) require keys (K) and values (V) from all visual partitions and one copy of the text. The gather_kv mode all-gathers visual K/V and combines them with local text K/V. This gives each rank the full key set, but each logical core must then hold the whole visual K/V sequence in its 24 GiB of HBM, so per-rank K/V memory does not shrink as the CP group grows. Ulysses and Ring organize these inputs differently, so their masks must follow the key order of each kernel call.
paragraphs.zh: 每个rank的查询（Q）需要来自所有视觉分区的键（K）和值（V），以及一份文本副本。 gather_kv 模式对视觉 K/V 进行 all-gather，并与本地文本 K/V 合并。 这使每个rank拥有完整的键集合，但每个逻辑核心随后必须在其 24 GiB 的 HBM 中保存整个视觉 K/V 序列，因此每个rank的 K/V 显存不会随 CP 组的扩大而减少。 Ulysses 和 Ring 以不同方式组织这些输入，因此它们的掩码必须遵循每次 kernel 调用的键顺序。

paragraphs.en: Neuron compiles attention calls for fixed tensor shapes, so shorter text inputs retain padding. Padding keys must be excluded from softmax to preserve the weights on valid keys. When valid keys form a contiguous interval, Difflet passes its bounds to AWS’s fused attention kernel, which combines score computation, softmax, and value aggregation Amazon Web Services (2026e) ; Amazon Web Services (2026f) . For each tile of 128 queries, the Tensor Engine computes Q ​ K ⊤ QK^{\top} into PSUM. As the Vector Engine moves the scores to SBUF, it replaces those outside the interval with − ∞ -\infty and tracks each row’s running maximum; the Scalar Engine then computes the exponentials and their row sums. After a DMA transpose, the Tensor Engine multiplies the probabilities by V V , so the score matrix never returns to HBM. The kernel reads two bounds per query from HBM instead of a mask entry per query–key pair.
paragraphs.zh: Neuron 针对固定的张量形状编译注意力调用，因此较短的文本输入会保留填充（padding）。 必须将填充的键（key）从 softmax 中排除，以保持有效键上的权重。 当有效键构成一个连续区间时，Difflet 会将该区间的边界传递给 AWS 的融合注意力内核，该内核将分数计算、softmax 和数值聚合结合在一起 Amazon Web Services (2026e)；Amazon Web Services (2026f)。 对于每个包含 128 个查询（query）的分块，张量引擎将 Q ​ K ⊤ QK^{\top} 计算到 PSUM 中。 当向量引擎将分数移至 SBUF 时，它会将区间之外的分数替换为 − ∞ -\infty，并跟踪每一行的运行最大值；随后标量引擎计算指数值及其行和。 经过一次 DMA 转置后，张量引擎将概率乘以 V V，因此分数矩阵无需返回 HBM。 该内核从 HBM 中为每个查询读取两个边界，而不是为每个查询–键对读取一个掩码条目。

paragraphs.en: Independently normalized partials cannot be added, because each uses a different softmax denominator. For each query, each call therefore returns an unnormalized weighted value sum, the maximum score, and the sum of exponentials relative to that maximum. The kernel keeps these statistics in SBUF and writes them to HBM in its tile layout, one query per partition, which Difflet reorders to query order. Outside the kernel, Difflet rescales both sums to a common maximum and adds them across partitions. Dividing the combined weighted sum by the combined exponential sum restores joint normalization without gathering all visual K/V Dao et al. (2022) ; Liu et al. (2023) . The outputs retain Q’s layout: local visual tokens and replicated text.

paragraphs.en: Nearby diffusion steps can produce similar denoiser outputs. Difflet uses this similarity to replace some full denoiser executions with estimates. The skip decision changes from step to step, so Difflet makes it on the host, outside the compiled denoiser. The host stores the previous output used by the generation loop and its most recently measured change. A full execution measures the change relative to the previously used output, then saves the new output. A cached step adds the saved change to the previous output and stores the estimate for the next step. Both paths apply the same numerical update rule to the latent, reducing denoiser calls while retaining every sampling step. This output estimator supports three caching modes: fixed cadence , calibrated adaptive , and online-delta . They differ in when to replace a full denoiser execution with an estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 相邻的扩散步骤可能产生相近的去噪器输出。 Difflet 利用这种相似性，用估计值替代部分完整的去噪器执行。 跳过决策随步骤而变化，因此 Difflet 在主机侧（编译后的去噪器之外）做出该决策。 主机存储生成循环所使用的上一次输出及其最近一次测得的变化量。 完整执行会相对于上次使用的输出测量变化量，然后保存新输出。 缓存步骤将已保存的变化量加到上一次输出上，并将该估计值存储起来供下一步使用。 两条路径都对潜变量应用相同的数值更新规则，从而在保留每个采样步骤的同时减少去噪器调用次数。 该输出估计器支持三种缓存模式：固定节奏（fixed cadence）、校准自适应（calibrated adaptive）和在线增量（online-delta）。 它们的区别在于何时用估计值替代完整的去噪器执行。

paragraphs.en: The calibrated adaptive mode needs a signal that costs less to obtain than the computation it can save. TeaCache Liu et al. (2025a) motivates using changes in early model features to estimate later output changes. On Trainium, these features remain inside a program compiled before inference. Observing them requires the program to expose a result, but returning a large feature array to the host for comparison would introduce communication overhead. paragraphs.en: To keep the saved features on Trainium across calls, Difflet assigns the probe’s new feature output to their existing memory through input–output aliasing Amazon Web Services (2026d) . paragraphs.zh: 为了让保存的特征在 Trainium 上跨调用保持有效，Difflet 通过输入–输出别名（Amazon Web Services (2026d)）将探针的新特征输出指派到其既有内存中。 比较完成后，当前特征会在那里替换旧特征，下一次调用直接读取它们。 由此，特征计算、比较和状态更新都发生在一次探针调用之内。 只有标量分数返回主机，从而把探针的输出传输从特征数组缩减为单个值。 保存的特征支持下一次比较；独立的主机输出历史则提供缓存的预测结果。

The controller compares the estimated output change with a threshold, either separately for each step or accumulated across steps. Reaching the threshold triggers full execution and resets the sum when accumulation is used. paragraphs.en: Online-delta uses outputs already available on the host, avoiding a separate probe call. At a full step, it measures output change relative to the previously used output, which may have been estimated. If this change is below α \alpha times the first change measured in the generation, the next step is cached. That cached step must be followed by full execution to obtain a fresh measurement. Calibration can select this mode when early features poorly predict output changes but output changes remain related across neighboring steps. If neither signal is suitable, it selects fixed cadence, which caches at a preset interval without a change signal. Both modes are probe-free; their effect on final quality must be assessed through complete image or video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在线增量（Online-delta）利用主机上已有的输出，避免了单独的探测调用。 在完整步（full step）中，它衡量输出相对于先前所用输出的变化，而该输出可能是估计值。 如果这一变化低于 α \alpha 倍的本轮生成中测得的首次变化，则下一步将被缓存。 该被缓存的步之后必须执行完整计算，以获得新的测量值。 当早期特征对输出变化的预测效果较差，但相邻步之间的输出变化仍然相关时，校准可以选择此模式。 如果两种信号都不适用，则选择固定节奏（fixed cadence）模式，即在没有变化信号的情况下按预设间隔缓存。 这两种模式都无需探测；它们对最终质量的影响必须通过完整的图像或视频生成来评估。

paragraphs.en: Serving applies the same boundary across requests: programs and weights stay loaded, while each request’s sampling and caching state starts fresh on the host. Difflet separates request handling from model execution using two host processes (Figure 4 ). The API process validates requests, manages the queue, and returns results. A single resident model process loads the components for text encoding, denoising, and decoding, and retains them across requests. The process coordinates all three stages and manages the assigned cores. Keeping them resident avoids repeated runtime initialization and weight loading. This separation allows the model process to be restarted without restarting the API process.
paragraphs.zh: 服务化在所有请求间采用相同的边界：程序和权重保持常驻加载，而每个请求的采样与缓存状态在主机上都是全新开始。 Difflet 使用两个主机进程将请求处理与模型执行分离（图 4）。 API 进程负责验证请求、管理队列并返回结果。 单一的常驻模型进程加载用于文本编码、去噪和解码的各组件，并在请求之间保留它们。 该进程协调全部三个阶段，并管理所分配的核心。 让这些组件常驻可避免重复的运行时初始化和权重加载。 这种分离使模型进程可以在不重启 API 进程的情况下被重启。

paragraphs.en: Components that stay resident together share the same cores, which constrains both their parallel configurations and their memory. In our NxD execution path, resident components share the same set of cores, although their TP degrees can differ. For FLUX, the denoiser’s weights are partitioned across four cores (TP=4), while each core holds a full copy of the VAE weights (TP=1). Each component must be compiled for this shared set of cores and its own TP degree. Device memory must accommodate all resident weights, including the VAE replicas, and execution buffers.
paragraphs.zh: 常驻在一起的组件共享相同的核，这同时限制了它们的并行配置和内存。 在我们的 NxD 执行路径中，常驻组件共享同一组核，尽管它们的 TP 度可以不同。 对于 FLUX，去噪器的权重分布在四个核上（TP=4），而每个核都持有一份完整的 VAE 权重副本（TP=1）。 每个组件都必须针对这组共享的核以及自身的 TP 度进行编译。 设备内存必须容纳所有常驻权重，包括 VAE 副本以及执行缓冲区。

paragraphs.en: At startup, Difflet configures the model process using a serving profile that specifies the model, supported input shapes, data type, and parallel configuration. It selects the corresponding compiled artifacts and checks that their core assignments match this configuration before loading them. The model process then runs a test generation to check that the loaded components work together. It validates the output before becoming ready to execute requests (Figure 4 (a)). After a restart, the process reloads the saved artifacts and repeats these checks.
paragraphs.zh: 启动时，Difflet 使用一个服务配置文件来配置模型进程，该配置文件指定了模型、支持的输入形状、数据类型和并行配置。 它会选择对应的编译产物，并在加载之前检查这些产物的核心分配是否与该配置匹配。 随后，模型进程会运行一次测试生成，以检查加载的组件能否协同工作。 它会先验证输出，然后才进入可执行请求的就绪状态（图 4 (a)）。 重启之后，该进程会重新加载已保存的产物，并重复上述检查。

sents.en: At startup, Difflet configures the model process using a serving profile that specifies the model, supported input shapes, data type, and parallel configuration.
sents.zh: 启动时，Difflet 使用一个服务配置文件来配置模型进程，该配置文件指定了模型、支持的输入形状、数据类型和并行配置。

sents.en: It selects the corresponding compiled artifacts and checks that their core assignments match this configuration before loading them.
sents.zh: 它会选择对应的编译产物，并在加载之前检查这些产物的核心分配是否与该配置匹配。

sents.en: It validates the output before becoming ready to execute requests (Figure 4 (a)).
sents.zh: 它会先验证输出，然后才进入可执行请求的就绪状态（图 4 (a)）。

sents.en: After a restart, the process reloads the saved artifacts and repeats these checks.
sents.zh: 重启之后，该进程会重新加载已保存的产物，并重复上述检查。

paragraphs.en: During serving, the API process checks requests against the serving profile and places accepted requests in a bounded queue, rejecting new requests when the queue is full. The model process handles queued requests one at a time to prevent concurrent changes to the pipeline’s sampling and caching state. Each request needs its own sampling and caching state. The model process therefore initializes the latent and timestep schedule for each generation. When step caching is enabled, it also clears the controller’s output history to prevent reuse of predictions from a previous request. The model process returns the result to the API process (Figure 4 (b)).
paragraphs.zh: 在服务期间，API 进程根据服务配置文件检查请求，并将接受的请求放入一个有界队列中，当队列已满时拒绝新请求。 模型进程一次处理一个排队请求，以防止对流水线的采样和缓存状态的并发更改。 每个请求都需要自己的采样和缓存状态。 因此，模型进程为每次生成初始化潜变量和时间步调度。 当启用步进缓存时，它还会清除控制器的输出历史，以防止重用上一个请求的预测结果。 模型进程将结果返回给 API 进程（图 4（b））。

sents.en: The model process handles queued requests one at a time to prevent concurrent changes to the pipeline’s sampling and caching state.

sents.en: The model process therefore initializes the latent and timestep schedule for each generation.
sents.zh: 因此，模型进程为每次生成初始化潜变量和时间步调度。

sents.en: When step caching is enabled, it also clears the controller’s output history to prevent reuse of predictions from a previous request.
sents.zh: 当启用步进缓存时，它还会清除控制器的输出历史，以防止重用上一个请求的预测结果。

sents.en: The model process returns the result to the API process (Figure 4 (b)).

paragraphs.en: Recovery. When a request times out or the model process fails, Difflet pauses dispatch before attempting recovery. A timeout may leave device computation running, so Difflet first requests cancellation and waits for the current generation to stop. If cancellation succeeds, the same model process can handle subsequent requests. Otherwise, Difflet terminates the process and confirms its exit before starting a replacement. A model process failure also triggers replacement. The new process reloads the saved artifacts and passes the startup checks before dispatch resumes (Figure 4 (c)). If recovery fails, dispatch remains paused.
paragraphs.zh: 恢复。 当请求超时或模型进程失败时，Difflet 会在尝试恢复之前暂停分发。 超时可能会使设备端计算仍在运行，因此 Difflet 首先请求取消，并等待当前生成停止。 如果取消成功，同一个模型进程可以继续处理后续请求。 否则，Difflet 会终止该进程并确认其退出，然后才启动替代进程。 模型进程失败也会触发替代。 新进程会重新加载已保存的工件并通过启动检查，然后分发才会恢复（图 4 (c)）。 如果恢复失败，分发将保持暂停状态。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Difflet on five image and video models and ask five questions: how fast Difflet is end to end (§ 7.2 ), which mechanism the speedup comes from (§ 7.3 ), which parallel configurations pay off (§ 7.4 ), what step caching saves and costs (§ 7.5 ), and what resident serving buys in startup and recovery (§ 7.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在五个图像与视频模型上评估 Difflet，并提出五个问题：Difflet 的端到端速度有多快（§ 7.2）、加速来自哪种机制（§ 7.3）、哪些并行配置是划算的（§ 7.4）、步进缓存节省了什么又付出了什么代价（§ 7.5），以及常驻服务在启动与恢复方面带来了什么收益（§ 7.6）。

paragraphs.en: Request latency is the time to generate one output with the model already resident, measured through difflet serve , over HTTP for Wan and LTX-2, where returning the output adds well under a second. Standalone latency additionally covers process start and model loading: a cold run first flushes the host page cache, a warm run reuses the cached weight files but still loads them onto the device. Denoising time is the wall time of the denoising loop, including steps served from the cache, and step latency is the median time of an uncached step, excluding the first; with sequential CFG it covers both passes. Compilation is a one-time build into empty caches and is reported separately. Resident request latency is the median of five requests after one warm-up for image models and of three for video models; standalone runs and compilations are measured once. The device slows by up to 25–30% under back-to-back load and recovers after 90 s of idle, so every resident measurement idles the device for 90 s first.

paragraphs.en: Once a model is resident, request latency is mostly denoising—except on the video pipelines with heavy stages around the denoiser. paragraphs.en: Difflet’s generality costs no denoising performance against NxDI. On FLUX.1-dev, the one model NxDI supports, both systems run a 270 ms denoiser step, because both use the same family of NKI attention kernels. Difflet is faster end to end because of loading: NxDI loads the full diffusers pipeline on the host in every process and warms up each component, whereas Difflet reads checkpoints already split per core at compile time. Warm latency falls from 66.3 to 47.6 s and the Neuron weight load from 43 to 23 s, for a compilation one minute longer (16.7 against 15.7 min), into which the checkpoint splitting moves.
paragraphs.zh: 与 NxDI 相比，Difflet 的通用性并未付出降噪性能的代价。 在 FLUX.1-dev（NxDI 支持的唯一模型）上，两个系统的降噪器单步运行时间均为 270 ms，因为两者使用同一族的 NKI 注意力内核。 由于加载方式不同，Difflet 的端到端速度更快：NxDI 在每个进程中都在主机上加载完整的 diffusers 流水线并对每个组件进行预热，而 Difflet 读取的是在编译时就已按核心切分好的检查点。 热启动延迟从 66.3 秒降至 47.6 秒，Neuron 权重加载时间从 43 秒降至 23 秒，代价是编译时间多了一分钟（16.7 分钟对 15.7 分钟），检查点切分的工作被转移到了这段编译时间里。

paragraphs.en: Each mechanism dominates on different models. Together they cut request latency by 3.0–8.5 × \times on the four models with a PyTorch/XLA baseline. Resident serving is the largest single step on the image models (3.35 × \times on FLUX, 2.33 × \times on Qwen-Image) and on HunyuanVideo (2.35 × \times ), because a standalone request pays process start, pipeline construction, and a 10–140 s device weight load on every call. The attention kernel gives 1.93 × \times on HunyuanVideo and 1.32–1.37 × \times on the image models; on LTX-2 its 1.24 × \times faster denoiser step would save 4 s of a 110 s run, and the measured difference (0.1 s) is within the run-to-run spread (106–113 s). Presharding matters where the checkpoint is large relative to the rest of the pipeline: 1.69 × \times on LTX-2, whose 19B denoiser takes 38–42 s to shard on the host, and 1.53 × \times on Wan, whose text encoder and denoiser take 173 and 354 s. Step caching adds 1.40–1.64 × \times where the request is mostly denoising, 1.33 × \times on Wan, and 1.17 × \times on LTX-2.
paragraphs.zh: 每种机制在不同的模型上占主导地位。 在四个以 PyTorch/XLA 为基线的模型上，二者结合将请求延迟降低了 3.0–8.5 × \times 倍。 常驻服务在图像模型上（FLUX 上 3.35 × \times，Qwen-Image 上 2.33 × \times）以及 HunyuanVideo 上（2.35 × \times）是单项提升最大的一步，因为独立请求在每次调用时都要付出进程启动、流水线构建以及 10–140 秒的设备权重加载开销。 注意力核在 HunyuanVideo 上带来 1.93 × \times 的提升，在图像模型上为 1.32–1.37 × \times；在 LTX-2 上，其去噪器单步 1.24 × \times 的加速本可在一个 110 秒的运行中节省 4 秒，而实测差异（0.1 秒）处于运行间波动范围（106–113 秒）之内。 当检查点相对于流水线的其余部分较大时，预分片很重要：在 LTX-2 上为 1.69 × \times，其 19B 去噪器在主机上分片需要 38–42 秒；在 Wan 上为 1.53 × \times，其文本编码器和去噪器分别需要 173 秒和 354 秒。 步骤缓存在请求以去噪为主的场景下额外带来 1.40–1.64 × \times 的提升，在 Wan 上为 1.33 × \times，在 LTX-2 上为 1.17 × \times。

paragraphs.en: At 4.1k tokens, tensor parallelism over all four cores is the latency default. Every configuration that keeps four cores on one request stays within 3.5% of TP4 (Table 5 ). Sequence parallelism and gather-based context parallelism add 2% per step (278.7 and 278.8 against 272.5 ms); Ulysses and ring attention remove 3% and 2% (263.3 and 268.2 ms), half a second on a 14 s request. At this length the activations that sequence parallelism shards and the keys and values that context parallelism exchanges are small, so the extra collectives cost about what the split saves. Ulysses, which trades the sequence split for a head split with one all-to-all on each side of attention, is the fastest of the three context-parallel modes; it and ring attention are the only configurations faster than TP4, by 3% and 2%. Halving the cores to TP2 costs 1.87 × \times per step, so tensor parallelism scales from two to four cores at 94% efficiency.

paragraphs.en: Data parallelism buys throughput only marginally once models are resident. Two TP2 replicas, started together on separate core pairs, finish two requests in 26.7 s, against 27.9 s for TP4 serving them in turn: 5% more throughput for almost twice the latency. Each replica’s step (529.6 ms) is 4% slower than a TP2 replica running alone, so the replicas contend slightly for the chip’s shared resources. Data parallelism therefore pays only when per-request work outside the device, such as loading, dominates; in a resident server it does not.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦模型常驻显存，数据并行对吞吐量的提升就十分有限。 两个 TP2 副本分别在独立的核心对上同时启动，用 26.7 秒完成两个请求，而 TP4 依次处理这两个请求需要 27.9 秒：延迟几乎翻倍，吞吐量仅提高 5%。 每个副本的单步耗时（529.6 毫秒）比单独运行的 TP2 副本慢 4%，说明副本之间对芯片共享资源的争用较为轻微。 因此，数据并行只有在设备之外的每请求开销（如加载）占主导时才有收益；在常驻服务场景中则不然。

paragraphs.en: At 32.8k tokens, sequence parallelism pays, and the configurations that split the model in halves do not run. Sequence parallelism splits across the four cores the per-token work that tensor parallelism repeats on each of them over the full sequence—the norms, modulation, and residual additions—and at this length that cuts Wan’s denoiser step by 7% (13.9 against 14.9 s) and its warm request by 4% (933 against 974 s). Ulysses context parallelism over two TP2 pairs compiles but does not load: the static DMA rings the compiler emits for its spill traffic need 43 MiB more HBM than is free beside the resident text encoder. The TP2 program, with or without CFG batching, holds half the model and the full 32.8k-token sequence on each core, and the compiler backend exhausts the host’s 124 GiB building it, in both attempts. CFG parallelism, which at short sequences removes work rather than moving it, and the data-parallel pair are therefore unavailable at this length, and the limit is the compiler’s host memory rather than the device’s.
paragraphs.zh: 在 32.8k token 规模下，序列并行开始有收益，而将模型对半拆分的那几种配置则无法运行。 序列并行把张量并行在每个核心上对整个序列重复执行的逐 token 工作——归一化、调制和残差加法——拆分到四个核心上，在这个长度下，这使 Wan 的去噪步耗时降低 7%（13.9 秒对比 14.9 秒），热请求耗时降低 4%（933 秒对比 974 秒）。 跨两个 TP2 组合的 Ulysses 上下文并行可以编译通过但无法加载：编译器为其溢出流量生成的静态 DMA 环需要的 HBM 比常驻文本编码器旁的空闲空间多出 43 MiB。 无论是否使用 CFG 批处理，TP2 程序都会在每个核心上保存一半模型和完整的 32.8k token 序列，两次尝试中编译器后端在构建时都耗尽了主机的 124 GiB 内存。 因此，CFG 并行（在短序列时是消除工作而非搬移工作）和数据并行组合在这个长度下均不可用，其限制来自编译器的主机内存而非设备内存。

paragraphs.en: Ulysses context parallelism handles padded prompts correctly, to within BF16 rounding. Under Ulysses, each core holds a slice of the sequence and the all-to-all hands it a slice of the heads over the whole sequence, so the text padding mask travels as a count of valid keys. We run the HunyuanVideo denoiser (two dual-stream and two single-stream blocks at 320 × 512 × 61 320{\times}512{\times}61 ) as TP2CP2 with Ulysses and as TP2 alone, one compiled program per configuration, at five prompt lengths from 5 to 256 valid text tokens passed as a runtime input. The two configurations differ by at most 7.8 × 10 − 2 7.8{\times}10^{-2} (mean 3.7 × 10 − 3 3.7{\times}10^{-3} , cosine similarity 0.99992) on outputs of magnitude up to 3.3, a few BF16 rounding steps, and the difference does not grow with prompt length. Changing the prompt length moves the output 8–27 × \times more than that (mean 3.1 × 10 − 2 3.1{\times}10^{-2} to 1.0 × 10 − 1 1.0{\times}10^{-1} ), so a mask the split mishandled would show.
paragraphs.zh: Ulysses 上下文并行能正确处理带填充的提示，误差仅在 BF16 舍入范围内。 在 Ulysses 下，每个核心持有序列的一个分片，而 all-to-all 操作会把整个序列的某个注意力头分片交给它，因此文本填充掩码以有效键的数量形式传递。 我们以 TP2CP2 配合 Ulysses 以及单独 TP2 两种方式运行 HunyuanVideo 去噪器（两个双流块和两个单流块，尺寸为 320 × 512 × 61 320{\times}512{\times}61），每种配置各编译一份程序，在从 5 到 256 个有效文本词元的五个提示长度下、以运行时输入的形式传入进行测试。 在幅值高达 3.3 的输出上，两种配置的差异至多为 7.8 × 10 − 2 7.8{\times}10^{-2}（均值 3.7 × 10 − 3 3.7{\times}10^{-3}，余弦相似度 0.99992），即几个 BF16 舍入步长，且该差异不随提示长度增长。 改变提示长度所引起的输出变化是前者的 8–27 × \times 倍（均值从 3.1 × 10 − 2 3.1{\times}10^{-2} 到 1.0 × 10 − 1 1.0{\times}10^{-1}），因此如果切分处理掩码有误，就会显现出来。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the three caching modes of Section 5 : fixed cadence at cadence 2; online-delta at its default α = 0.6 \alpha=0.6 , untuned; and calibrated adaptive , with its curve fitted per model on prompts other than the evaluation prompts and its threshold set to cadence 2’s skip budget. All modes keep 5 initial and 5 final full steps, so within a model they differ mainly in which steps they cache. As a further baseline, fewer steps runs without caching at the number of denoiser calls cadence 2 executes. Figure 8 reports the speedups and the quality.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估第 5 节中的三种缓存模式：固定节奏（fixed cadence），节奏为 2；在线增量（online-delta），使用其默认的 \alpha=0.6 且未调参；以及校准自适应（calibrated adaptive），其曲线在每个模型上使用除评估提示之外的其他提示进行拟合，其阈值设为节奏 2 的跳过预算。 所有模式都保留 5 个初始步骤和 5 个最终完整步骤，因此在同一模型内它们的主要差异在于缓存哪些步骤。 作为进一步的基线，更少步数（fewer steps）在节奏 2 所执行的去噪器调用次数下不使用缓存运行。 图 8 报告了加速比和质量。

paragraphs.en: Caching saves the skipped denoiser calls, not time per call. An executed call costs the same in every mode—830–845 ms on HunyuanVideo, 835 ms on Qwen-Image—and a cached step costs 0.3–7 ms. The speedup is therefore set by the fraction of calls skipped. Because the initial and final full steps are fixed, official step counts skip proportionally more than short runs: cadence 2 skips 20 of 50 steps for a ceiling of 1.67 × \times and reaches 1.66–1.68 × \times ; on LTX-2 it skips 15 of 40 for a ceiling of 1.60 × \times . Wan is the exception, for a reason outside the cache: its caching-off loop runs for 12 minutes, during which the device throttles each executed call from 6.4 to 7.4 s, so a run with fewer calls is also faster per call and cadence 2 reaches 1.76 × \times . Running fewer steps with the same number of calls takes the same time to within 0.5% on every model, Wan included, so between caching and fewer steps the question is quality alone.

paragraphs.en: At the same number of denoiser calls, caching keeps far more of the output than sampling fewer steps. paragraphs.en: Calibrated adaptive is decided by how well its signal predicts, not by what the signal costs. Every model runs the probe on the device (Table 6 ), including HunyuanVideo, whose probe loads beside its denoiser at this shape. The probe costs 2–18 ms per step, 0.6–2% of a denoiser call, so at the same skip count the mode lands within 4% of cadence 2’s time. What separates the models is the fit: the curve explains 60–82% of the variance in output change on four models but 13% on Wan, where a timing gain is no evidence that the mode skips the right steps.
paragraphs.zh: 校准式自适应取决于其信号的预测能力，而不是该信号的代价。 每个模型都在设备上运行探针（表 6），包括 HunyuanVideo，其探针在该形状下与去噪器一同加载。 探针每步开销为 2–18 ms，占一次去噪器调用的 0.6–2%，因此在相同跳过次数下，该模式的时间落在节奏 2 时间的 4% 以内。 区分这些模型的是拟合度：该曲线解释了四个模型上输出变化 60–82% 的方差，但在 Wan 上仅解释 13%，在那里时间上的收益并不能证明该模式跳过了正确的步骤。

paragraphs.en: A restart costs a load, not a compile—unless the probe changes. The first start of a serving profile compiles its programs and takes 18–117 min (Table 7 ). Every later start validates them and pays the weight load, which the host page cache bounds: 91–786 s warm, 340–1,102 s cold. Changing the caching target recompiles nothing, but switching from caching off to calibrated adaptive rebuilds the program that carries the probe: FLUX’s whole pipeline program (1,353 s) and Qwen-Image’s denoiser (1,419 s).

paragraphs.en: Recovery leaves no state behind. We test both failure paths on FLUX, repeating one prompt and seed; two reference requests produce byte-identical images. A 5 s request timeout returns an error at 5.0 s, and the same model process serves again 9.3 s later, once its running denoising loop reaches the next cancellation point. Killing the model process with SIGKILL mid-request returns an error after 0.6 s; Difflet spawns a new one, reloads the weights, and is ready 65.6 s after the kill. After both faults the same seed reproduces the reference image byte for byte, so no sampling or caching state survives a request.

paragraphs.en: Under load, splitting the chip into replicas does not pay for resident FLUX. Table 8 offers both configurations the same Poisson arrivals. At no load level does DP2 × \times TP2 beat TP4: their median latency ties at ρ = 0.78 \rho=0.78 , and at ρ = 0.99 \rho=0.99 TP4’s median is 33.0 s against 46.7 s, with the 30 s SLO met for 40% of requests against 25%. Each TP2 replica needs 26–27 s for a request that TP4 serves in 14.2 s, so a request that finds a replica idle already spends most of the SLO, while the second replica adds only the 5% of throughput measured in Section 7.4 . Both configurations complete the same number of requests per hour at every level, because arrivals, not capacity, limit them. Queueing dominates both: past ρ ≈ 1 \rho\approx 1 the 99th percentile exceeds 100 s for either configuration. With 20 requests per level these percentiles are coarse—TP4’s median is higher at ρ = 0.78 \rho=0.78 than at ρ = 0.99 \rho=0.99 (39.4 against 33.0 s)—but at every level TP4 has the lower 99th percentile and meets the SLO at least as often. paragraphs.en: On Trainium, a diffusion model runs as fixed-shape programs compiled ahead of time, while its pipeline, prompts, and caching decisions keep changing. Difflet runs each model’s pipeline on the host over one compilation backend, splits joint attention across cores so that it matches unsplit attention, and skips denoising steps under host control. Device probes keep comparison state on Trainium and return one score per step to the host, while the resident model process keeps every program loaded across requests. Together, these mechanisms provide a common inference and serving framework for five image and video model families. The broader lesson is to decide early what each program fixes and what the host may still change: Difflet compiles shapes, parallel configurations, and kernels once, and exchanges per-request and per-step information with the device as small runtime values—a count of valid text keys going in, one change score per step coming out.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Trainium 上，扩散模型以预先编译好的固定形状程序运行，而其流水线、提示词和缓存决策却在不断变化。 Difflet 在主机上通过单一编译后端运行每个模型的流水线，将联合注意力拆分到多个核上并使其与未拆分的注意力相匹配，并在主机控制下跳过去噪步骤。 设备探针在 Trainium 上保留比较状态，并向主机返回每步一个分数，而常驻的模型进程则在每个请求之间保持所有程序处于已加载状态。 这些机制共同为五个图像和视频模型家族提供了统一的推理与服务框架。 更广泛的教训是尽早决定每个程序固定什么、主机仍可改变什么：Difflet 只编译一次形状、并行配置和内核，并与设备以小型运行时数值交换逐请求和逐步的信息——送入的是有效文本键的数量，送出的是每步一个变化分数。
